title: Price drop on saved property
description: Notify interested buyers when a saved property's price drops. A marketing WhatsApp template with old and new price and link.
notes: Show both prices so the saving is concrete. Honest urgency like viewings scheduled this week works better than vague pressure.

body.text: Good news, {{first_name}}! The price of *{{address}}* just dropped from {{old_price}} to {{new_price}}. It is one of the properties you saved.
